# HeightField

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** world · **Folder:** [`src/logic/components/`](../folders/src-logic-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/components/rigid_body.h`](../../../src/logic/components/rigid_body.h)

## Summary

Static Jolt height field of rolling hills, a sum of random plane waves, centred on the origin.

## Description

Rolling-hills ground of sphere_roll_hills: RigidBodySys draws `waves` plane waves into wave_list (from `seed`, or one draw of WorldRng when 0) and creates a static height field of samples x samples points spaced `spacing` on the STATIC layer, together with the grounds. height(x, z) is the smooth surface (defined in src/physics/height_field.cpp); size() = (samples - 1) * spacing. Scene JSON only.

## Scene JSON

"HeightField": { "samples" (power of 2, >= 8), "spacing" (> 0), "waves" (>= 0), "wavelength": [min, max] (0 < min <= max), "wave_slope", "friction", "restitution", "seed" (>= 0) }

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `samples` | `int` | 256 | per side, power of 2 >= 8 |
| `spacing` | `float` | 0.5 | metres between samples |
| `waves` | `int` | 6 | number of plane waves |
| `wavelength` | `glm::vec2` | (6, 40) | log-uniform range of the wavelengths, metres |
| `wave_slope` | `float` | 0.07 | steepest slope of each wave (amplitude x wavenumber) |
| `friction` | `float` | 1 | Jolt friction |
| `restitution` | `float` | 0 | Jolt restitution |
| `seed` | `uint32_t` | 0 | 0 = one draw of the world RNG |
| `wave_list` | `std::vector<HeightField::Wave {vec2 k; float amplitude; float phase}>` | empty | drawn at creation by RigidBodySys |
| `body` | `uint32_t` | 0xffffffff | JPH::BodyID, assigned by RigidBodySys |
